title: Index a position
summary: An index selects a position. NumPy, like Python lists, starts counting at zero.
introduction: An index selects a position. NumPy, like Python lists, starts counting at zero. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An index selects a position. NumPy, like Python lists, starts counting at zero.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np

values = np.array([5, 7, 9])
print(values[1])
blocks.title: Index a position

blocks.text: The output is 7, the second value.
